title: Applying a matter in the wrong place
odia:
ନିରିମାଇଲ
କାହିଁ କଥା ନେଇ କାହିଁ ମାଇଲ?
literal_meaning: Nirimaila! Taking a matter from where, where have you applied it?
meaning_odia: କେଉଁଠାର କଥା ନେଇ କେଉଁଠି ଲଗାଇଲ ବୋଲି କଥକ ପଚାରୁଛନ୍ତି। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହି ଢଗଟି ମାରିବାର ପ୍ରୟୋଗ କରିବା ଅର୍ଥରେ ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ଏହା ଗୋଟିଏ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗର କଥାକୁ ଅନ୍ୟ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗରେ ଅସଙ୍ଗତ ଭାବେ ଲଗାଇବା ଉପରେ ଆପତ୍ତି। ଆରମ୍ଭର ନିରିମାଇଲ ସମ୍ବୋଧନଟି ଅବିକଳ ରଖାଯାଇଛି; ତାହାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପରିଚୟ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The repeated where questions the leap from a matter’s original setting to its new use. The dictionary quotes the line under applying or using, so the final verb does not describe a blow. Our editorial reading hears a protest against making one context’s words serve an unrelated argument.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A comment about one project’s schedule is offered as evidence about another person’s honesty. Someone objects that the remark has been carried into a context it did not address.
cultural_context: The rhyme between the opening address and the final verb gives the objection a compact, pointed sound. Nirimaila is retained as an unexplained address; the question itself carries the contrast between where a matter came from and where it is being used.
